name: zybo
display_name: Digilent Zybo (Zynq-7000, exact board revision unconfirmed)
device_part_note: Digilent ships at least three Zybo revisions (original Zybo, Zybo Z7-10, Zybo Z7-20) on different Zynq-7000 parts. This project has not confirmed which one the user has. Look up the exact part number from Digilent's official Zybo product page / Master XDC before using this descriptor for a real bitstream.
notes: This board's pragma text is identical to the compiler's pre-existing (pre---board) hardcoded Xilinx defaults, so RTL output for this board is expected to be byte-identical to the --board-unset default -- only a new constraint-file skeleton is added.
